# GoFlyTexas

> Flight school, aircraft rental and discovery flights at Aero Valley Airport (52F), 104 Boeing Way, Roanoke, TX 76262 — north Dallas–Fort Worth. Phone (940) 905-3090. Office 8am–5pm daily; flights by appointment.

GoFlyTexas trains private, instrument and commercial pilots and flight instructors one-on-one in a fleet of Cessna 172s (glass-panel and round-gauge). All rental rates are wet (fuel included). A discovery flight is about an hour of flying with a certified instructor for a fixed all-in price.

## Key pages

- [Facts: rates, hours, location](https://www.goflytexas.com/facts): the current numbers on one page
- [Discovery flight](https://www.goflytexas.com/discovery-flight): what happens, what it costs, how to get here
- [Flight training programs](https://www.goflytexas.com/flight-training): private, instrument, commercial, CFI
- [Private pilot](https://www.goflytexas.com/private-pilot)
